account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 11:22 ET AGAINST THE MANDATED ACCOUNT BY THE 11:21 HOURLY. Portfolio, equity positions and option positions were each queried live and all three returned first time: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, with buying_power reading 1009.16 to match. Unchanged from the 10:23 read and from every read since 11:22 on 8/24 because nothing has traded - a conclusion drawn from a fresh pull, not an assumption that let the pull be skipped. BOTH POSITION LISTS ARE EMPTY, which is what discharges this slot's exit step rather than excusing it: no target, stop or time stop is reachable because no position carries one, and no option no-fly window is reachable because no contract is held. ZERO equity orders on a created_at floor of 2026-08-22 confirms from the broker that nothing has been executed. THE WHOLE BALANCE IS SETTLED, so the whole of it is deployable and no good-faith violation is reachable. ONE SPECIFICATION IS STILL LIVE AND WAS RE-QUOTED THIS HOUR RATHER THAN ASSUMED: BZ, 24 shares at a 15.95 limit, published 09:47, FORCED on item 2, fused to 15:30 ET today. It was CONFIRMED at 11:22 against a 16.16 bid / 16.17 ask with all three of its pre-registered invalidations tested and none tripped - the lowest post-publication five-minute low is 15.680 against a 15.44 kill level, the bid is 0.59 under the 16.75 left-behind line with even the 16.460 session high 0.29 below it, and no five-minute bar has closed under 15.71 all day. The limit was NOT raised. It commits 382.80 of the 1009.16 if it fills, 37.9% against the 40% single-name ceiling, leaving 626.36 uncommitted. THE CHANGE THIS HOUR IS REACHABILITY, NOT VALIDITY. BZ traded at or below 15.95 repeatedly from 09:50 through 10:53 - the last touch a 15.925 low in the 10:53 minute bar - and since 10:54 every minute low has been 16.000 or higher, with a new session high of 16.460 at 11:13. So the level was marketable for roughly an hour of this session with nothing resting to fill it, and now sits 0.21 under the market. The specification remains live and untriggered; it is simply less likely to fill than at either prior check. Priced against the 16.16 bid, the foregone entry is +5.04 or +1.32% unrealised. Only the BZ row below was re-quoted this hour; the remaining entryWatch and candidates rows carry their 09:47 quotes and their timestamps say so.

entryWatch.setup: BZ post-earnings day 1 - reported this morning before the open, SPECIFIED at 09:47 at a 15.95 limit for 24 shares, FORCED on item 2
entryWatch.trigger: CONFIRMED LIVE AT 11:22 FOR THE SECOND HOURLY RUNNING, LIMIT NOT RAISED, AND UNREACHABLE SINCE 10:53. BZ is 16.16 bid / 16.17 ask at 15:22:35.200799018Z, last 16.160, +4.66% against the 15.44 settled close on a 0.06% spread. ALL THREE PRE-REGISTERED INVALIDATIONS TESTED MECHANICALLY AND NONE TRIPPED. FIRST, a print below 15.44: NOT TRIPPED - the lowest post-publication five-minute low is 15.680 in the 10:00 bar, 0.24 clear, and nothing since 10:53 has traded below 15.925. SECOND, a bid above 16.75: NOT TRIPPED - 16.16 is 0.59 under it and the 16.460 session high set at 11:13 is still 0.29 below. THIRD, a five-minute close below 15.71 on rising volume: NOT TRIPPED on either half - no five-minute bar has closed under 15.71 today at all, and the lowest post-publication close of 15.755 at 10:00 came on 48,093 shares against the preceding bar's 59,354. THE SETUP IS INTACT AND ARGUABLY STRONGER: the post-gap reversal printed a new session high above the 16.31 of the opening recovery, and the heaviest bar of the last hour - 133,706 shares at 11:19 - traded 16.19 to 16.295 rather than breaking lower. THE HALF THAT CUTS THE OTHER WAY: the limit printed for roughly an hour of this session - through 09:50 to 10:10 as the last run recorded, then again from 10:48 to 10:53 on minute lows of 15.950, 15.945, 15.935, 15.930, 15.935 and 15.925 - and the position list is still empty. Twelfth consecutive specification to have its level reached without a fill. It now needs a 1.3% retrace to fill, with four hours left on the fuse. NOT RE-STRUCK HIGHER, AND THAT IS THE POINT: raising 15.95 to chase a name 0.21 away is the behaviour refused on FUTU at 117.90 and on BJ at 97.35, and it is refused here on this board's own entry on the same terms.
entryWatch.why: THE ENTRY IS FORCED ON ITEM 2 AND ON NOTHING ELSE, AND THE MARKING IS CONSISTENCY RATHER THAN SCRUPLE. BZ is +4.15%, not the +8% item 2 names outright, so the literal test is untripped - but the rule's stated preference is the day-2/3 pullback and not the spike, this is the spike day, and this board floored PDD on exactly that reasoning twenty-four hours ago. What makes it worth forcing: Q2 EPS 0.33 against 0.29 verified on a live calendar pull, a 13.8% beat, within half a point of the 14.3% that carried BJ yesterday, on a name marked DOWN into its own report - 17.46 on 8/10 to a 15.07 low and a 15.44 close on 8/24, the lowest close of the month, set on the session immediately before the print. That is item 5 in the shape that favours an entry rather than the crowded-bulls shape that refuses one. Then the tape did the thing worth paying for: gapped DOWN through that close to 15.21 in the first minute and was bought back to 16.31 inside four minutes, the exact inverse of UI opening at the high of the day and losing 13.7%, and of BEKE giving back an opening pop twice. The honest weakness, recorded beside it: the +20% target at 19.14 is above anything BZ has traded this month, the 8/10 high being 17.47.

entryWatch.setup: BJ post-earnings day 3 off the 8/21 beat - the ONLY candidate on the board that passes item 2 today, and refused anyway
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED ON THE FUTU PRINCIPLE, STATED IN THIS BOARD'S OWN WORDS AND APPLIED WHERE IT COSTS SOMETHING. BJ is 96.78 bid / 97.13 ask at 13:45:18.018929939Z, last 96.800, DOWN 1.74% against the 98.490 settled close, on a 0.36% spread; the session opened 98.10 and has printed a 96.315 low. That puts it BELOW the 97.35 limit this board killed in writing at 11:22 yesterday - and the FUTU row already answers this exact shape: a level withdrawn in writing does not become live again because the tape came back under it. Yesterday's row DID permit a fresh look at BJ on today's quotes rather than carrying the level, and the look was taken rather than skipped. The tape answered it: the 8/24 entry rested explicitly on a rotation, SPY down only 0.37% while QQQ fell 1.23%, and today SPY is +0.38% and QQQ +0.89% with BJ red into a green market. Not re-struck at 96.78, not at 96.42, not at any price today.
entryWatch.why: THE HARDEST CALL IN THIS RUN AND THE ONE THAT DECIDES WHETHER THE 8/18 RULE MEANS ANYTHING. BJ is the only name on the board that passes item 2 outright - day 3, down 1.74%, a genuine pullback into the 96.42 close of its own print day, off a verified 14.3% beat with the pre-print markdown to 88.22 that carries item 5. Every static measure says take it. Two things refuse it and they are independent. First, this board killed a BJ specification at 11:22 yesterday on a pre-registered invalidation, and re-entering the same name below the dead limit the next morning is structurally identical to what was refused for FUTU on 8/24 - and a board that applies its rule only to the name it does not want is not applying a rule. Second, the reason the 8/24 entry gave for owning BJ was a rotation, and that rotation has inverted inside one session. Buying it a dollar cheaper today would be buying the same trade after its stated support went away, which is the cheaper-therefore-better reasoning this book calls averaging down when it is honest. So the entry went to a name this board has never killed, marked forced, rather than to a cleaner checklist on a name it has.

entryWatch.setup: FUTU - the 117.90 limit this board published on 8/21 and WITHDREW at 11:21 the same day, now well ABOVE the level it was killed at
entryWatch.trigger: STILL DEAD, AND THE DISCIPLINE HAS NOW COST A WINNER. FUTU is 121.24 bid / 121.68 ask at 13:46:45.228612478Z, last 121.450, UP 4.86% against a 115.810 close. The withdrawn 117.90 limit is now 3.34 BELOW the bid, after nine consecutive re-quotes yesterday ran 0.49 above the tape, 0.06 below, then 1.76, 1.82, 2.23, 2.32 and 2.26 below. A fill at the dead level would today be 3.34 in the money. IT IS STILL NOT RE-STRUCK. The 8/21 finding that the drought test which killed it measured the wrong window remains a reason to repair the TEST, not a licence to buy the trade back.
entryWatch.why: RECORDED BECAUSE IT CUTS AGAINST THE BOARD AND BELONGS BESIDE TODAY'S ENTRY RATHER THAN IN A FOOTNOTE. Yesterday this row said FUTU was left dead at the maximum of temptation and the kill had cost nothing, because the tape was 2.26 below the withdrawn level. Today it is 3.34 above it and up 4.86% on the session, so the refusal that looked free has become expensive. That is the correct time to restate it rather than quietly drop it: if the rule against re-animating a dead level were suspended the first morning it cost money, it would not be a rule. The same sentence is what refuses BJ this morning, and the two have to be answered identically on the same day or neither is worth anything.

entryWatch.setup: BEKE post-earnings day 3 - the biggest beat of the cohort, refused on a level this board wrote before today
entryWatch.trigger: THE PRE-WRITTEN TRIGGER HAS STILL NOT FIRED, AND THE TAPE GOT WORSE RATHER THAN BETTER. Q2 0.42 against 0.28, a 50% beat, three times BZ's and the largest on this board. The condition written on 8/24 for revisiting it is a five-minute close back above 18.47 on volume. It has not happened. BEKE is 17.66 bid / 17.67 ask at 13:45:17.990152999Z, last 17.660, down 0.28% against a 17.710 close on a 0.06% spread - the tightest quote on this list. What refuses it: on 8/24 it opened 18.055, printed 18.47 within five minutes and closed at 17.710, which was EXACTLY the session low, a third consecutive failure to hold an opening pop. The trigger is unchanged and it is a level rather than a direction, for exactly that reason.
entryWatch.why: THE STRONGEST NUMBER ON THE BOARD ATTACHED TO THE WEAKEST TAPE, AND THE COMPARISON THAT MAKES TODAY'S ENTRY LEGIBLE. BEKE's beat is 50% against BZ's 13.8%, its spread is a quarter of BZ's, and its size fits comfortably. Every static measure favours BEKE. What separates them is behaviour after the number was known: BEKE has gapped up and sold three times running, closing 8/24 at its own low, while BZ gapped DOWN through its prior close and was bought back through it inside four minutes. The 2026-08-10 tiebreak says the number decides when a number and a thesis disagree; here two numbers disagree with each other, the beat against the tape, and the tape is the one measured AFTER the beat was known, so it carries the newer information. Refused on its own written level, which is the point of writing levels.

entryWatch.setup: BNS - day 1 of a real beat, refused on the WMT arithmetic rather than on the setup
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED ON THE EXIT FRAMEWORK, NOT ON THE PRINT. BNS reported this morning before the open: Q3 EPS 1.65 against a 1.53 estimate, a 7.8% beat, verified on a live calendar pull. It is 89.52 bid / 89.56 ask at 13:45:17.523471907Z, last 89.550, UP 3.07% against an 86.860 close, on a 0.04% spread - day 1 in exactly the same position as BZ. What kills it is arithmetic: a +20% target off 89.52 is 107.42 inside five sessions, which is not a move a Canadian bank produces, so target, stop and time stop would all be decoration. The same refusal that has kept WMT on watch rather than in the order.
entryWatch.why: THE CLOSEST STRUCTURAL RIVAL TO TODAY'S ENTRY AND THE REASON THE ENTRY WENT ELSEWHERE. BNS and BZ are the same trade on paper - day 1, real beat, bought on the print - so the choice between them is not about item 2, which both fail identically. It is about whether the exits are levels or decoration. BNS needs 107.42 in five sessions; it has traded a 85.97 to 92.04 range all month. BZ needs 19.14 against a 17.47 month high - also a reach, and named as one in the specification, but a reach of 10% above the range rather than 17%. Recorded so the ranking is a comparison rather than an assertion.

entryWatch.setup: PDD day 2 - the condition this board wrote yesterday, outcome-blind, and the answer it produced
entryWatch.trigger: THE WRITTEN CONDITION FAILED AND THE ROW IS HONOURED RATHER THAN REOPENED. The 8/24 entry stated that PDD would be re-examined today as a day-2 candidate IF the print-day reaction held. It did not: PDD opened 90.945, printed 91.90, and CLOSED 87.070 near its 86.190 low on 13,626,864 shares against a 5-6M run rate - a full print-day gain given back on 2.5x volume, and a close below the 88.380 it started the session it reported in. Today it is 86.26 bid / 86.37 ask at 13:42:29.049429876Z, down another 0.93%. The 2.9% beat was the smallest of the cohort and the tape has now spent two sessions agreeing with that.
entryWatch.why: THE VALUE OF THE ROW IS THAT THE CONDITION WAS WRITTEN BEFORE THE ANSWER WAS KNOWABLE. Yesterday's run named the test - does the reaction hold - twenty-four hours ahead of the session that would answer it, so today's run had to check a number rather than form a fresh opinion about a name it might have liked. The number is unambiguous: a 2.9% beat that gives back its entire print-day move on 2.5x volume and closes below where it started is a failed print, and no day-2 case survives it. Kept as dead rather than deleted because it is the clean example of a pre-written condition doing the work a same-day judgement would have done worse.

entryWatch.setup: UI post-earnings day 3 - green today, and still mechanically unbuyable

entryWatch.why: A MECHANICAL LIMIT DOING ITS JOB ON A DAY THE NAME IS GREEN, WHICH IS THE ONLY DAY IT IS WORTH RECORDING. Yesterday this row noted that UI's 19.4% beat - the biggest of the cohort - produced the worst tape, and item 5 predicted it. Today the tape has turned and the answer has not changed by a cent, because the ceiling is arithmetic and needs no opinion. Kept on the list as the standing reminder that the size of a beat is not the ranking and that a limit which only binds on red days is not a limit.

entryWatch.setup: WMT post-earnings day 4 - the best liquidity on the board, declined on arithmetic and now fading

WMT is 104.93 bid / 104.94 ask at 13:42:30.24385617Z, last 104.930, DOWN 1.46% against a 106.490 close, on a 0.010% spread - still the tightest quote on this board by an order of magnitude. Day 4 is past the day-2/3 window regardless, and the exit framework kills it first: a +20% target is about 126 inside five sessions, which this name does not produce.
entryWatch.why: THE ROW THAT SUPPLIES TODAY'S TAPE EVIDENCE FROM THE OTHER SIDE. Yesterday WMT was the strongest thing on the board and rose in every re-quote; today it is down 1.46% while QQQ is up 0.89%. BJ, ROST and TJX are doing the same thing. That is not four independent names weakening, it is one rotation unwinding, and it is the direct evidence that the macro argument behind yesterday's BJ entry has inverted rather than merely paused. The arithmetic refusal is unchanged and stands on its own; the tape is recorded because it is what refuses BJ a second time.

entryWatch.setup: The AI, semiconductor and nuclear complex into NVDA on 8/26 and MRVL on 8/27 - the best tape on the board and refused without being priced as a candidate
entryWatch.trigger: THE BRANCH BINDS TODAY AND TODAY IS THE DAY IT COSTS SOMETHING. This is the first of the three sessions - 8/25, 8/26, 8/27 - that the 8/21 branch was written six sessions early to govern, and the complex is the strongest thing on the board: SMCI 37.82 bid, UP 7.54% against a 35.170 close; FUTU 121.24, up 4.86%; NVDA 213.28, up 2.30% against a 208.480 close and reporting TOMORROW after the bell; SMR 9.20, up 1.66%; OKLO 40.31, up 1.56%; IONQ 41.38, up 0.78%. Every one of them is refused, unpriced as a candidate and unranked. The arithmetic is unchanged: a -8% stop does not survive an event whose implied move is wider than 8%, so the realistic bad case gaps through the exit rather than filling at it. AMD remains separately refused on the single-name ceiling.
entryWatch.why: A BRANCH THAT ONLY BINDS ON DAYS WHEN IT COSTS NOTHING IS NOT A BRANCH, AND YESTERDAY IT COST NOTHING. On 8/24 this complex was down 5-6% across the board and refusing it looked like judgement; today it is up 1 to 7.5% and refusing it is the same decision with the sign reversed. Nothing about the reasoning changed between those two mornings, which is the entire test of writing a branch in advance. The NVDA spot has also moved against the range this board carried: 213.28 today against 208.83 on 8/24 and 215.01 on 8/21, so an implied range struck off any of those figures is already stale - a second reason not to size an event trade off a carried number. Today's entry is deliberately outside this complex.

entryWatch.setup: DKS - the biggest single move on the board today, and the pattern the rulebook refuses by name
entryWatch.trigger: A MISS AND A COLLAPSE, NOT A SETUP. DKS reported this morning before the open and MISSED: 3.53 actual against a 3.88 estimate, verified on a live calendar pull. It is 138.39 bid / 138.53 ask at 13:46:50.016762386Z, last 138.470, DOWN 22.83% against a 179.330 close. Not a candidate at any price until it makes a higher low.
entryWatch.why: LOGGED AS THE COUNTER-EXAMPLE THAT KEEPS TODAY'S ENTRY HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS AND IS NOT BUYING. Same session, same slot, two names that reported before the open: one beat by 13.8% and was bought through its own gap-down, one missed by 9% and lost 22.8%. The rulebook lists averaging into a name the tape has already judged under does-not-fit by name, and the KLAR row is the standing example. A cheap price after a miss is not a discount, and the fact that BZ's entry is also being struck below the market is not the same thing - one is a pullback inside an up move, the other is a catch inside a collapse.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR - bouncing off 14.00 after collapsing on its own 8/18 beat
entryWatch.trigger: STILL A FALLING KNIFE AND STILL NO HIGHER LOW. KLAR is 14.05 bid / 14.10 ask at 13:46:46.045996312Z, last 14.080, down 0.21% against a 14.110 close - lower than the 14.51 it was quoted at yesterday, so the fourth bounce has failed too. It beat on 8/18, 0.01 against -0.06, and fell 22.8% that session on 34.5M shares against a 3M run rate, then to 14.00 by 8/20. Not a candidate at any price until it makes a higher low.
entryWatch.why: THE SETUP THAT LOOKS MOST LIKE THIS BOOK'S FAVOURITE AND IS ACTUALLY ITS OPPOSITE, kept because DKS just reproduced it live. A recent beat plus a bounce off a round number reads as a post-earnings pullback entry and is not one: the pullback this rulebook buys is a pause after strength, whereas KLAR fell 26% in four sessions FROM its beat. Whatever the market objected to is not in the EPS line, and 34.5M shares against a 3M run rate says the objection was held with conviction. The row has now been right for five consecutive sessions at no cost, which is worth noting given that the FUTU row above has just been wrong at real cost - both are recorded, and neither result changes the rule that produced it.
